notes.title: 📢 Update: Level Design tweaks & improved enemy death animations!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

We've just rolled out an update with some improvements to level design and enemy death effects to enhance the gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

🔹 [b]Level 1-4 Design Update[/b]

Adjusted layouts and obstacles to improve flow and pacing.
Tweaked enemy placements for better challenge balancing.
Optimized visual elements to enhance immersion.

🦊 [b]Fox Knight death animation & effect overhaul[/b]

The Fox Knight now has a smoother death sequence.
Added a fade-out effect after the death animation for a more cinematic experience.
Improved transitions to ensure a polished and immersive effect.
We hope you enjoy these updates! Let us know your feedback in the discussions or reviews. More improvements coming soon! 🚀

notes.title: Cat Dimension is now 80% off: help us revive this hidden gem with your feedback!
notes.content:
Get ready to embark on a nostalgic journey through an intergalactic adventure with Cat Dimension, now available at an astonishing 80% discount on Steam. 🥳 Whether you’re a fan of classic platformers, a cat lover, or someone who enjoys quirky, imaginative narratives, this game promises to be an unforgettable experience. Let’s dive into what makes Cat Dimension special and why your feedback is crucial for its future development.

➡️ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839780/Cat_Dimension/]Cat Dimension on Steam[/url]

[h3]Discover the charming world of Cat Dimension[/h3]

Cat Dimension is a retro-inspired platformer that takes you on a thrilling journey through a fantastical universe where cats reign supreme. The game introduces you to a vibrant world filled with colorful landscapes, challenging levels, and adorable feline characters. Each level is meticulously designed to offer a fresh experience, keeping players engaged and entertained with its old-school charm.

From the moment you start playing, you’ll be captivated by the game’s charming aesthetic. The developers have poured their hearts into creating a visually stunning environment that draws players into the story. The attention to detail is evident in every aspect, from the fluid animations of the cat characters to the lush backgrounds that make each level feel alive.

Curious? Go check the trailer here 👉 

[previewyoutube=8Jb8GJn1Ljk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]An engaging storyline[/h3]

At the core of Cat Dimension is a heartwarming and engaging storyline. You play as a brave cat hero tasked with saving your dimension from impending doom. The narrative unfolds through a series of exciting missions that require agility and quick thinking. The characters you meet along the way add depth to the story, each with their unique personalities and backstories.

The storyline is designed to appeal to both young and old players. It’s a tale of courage, friendship, and perseverance, with enough twists and turns to keep you hooked until the very end. The dialogue is witty and often humorous, adding a layer of charm that enhances the overall experience.

[h3]Gameplay mechanics that delight[/h3]

One of the standout features of Cat Dimension is its innovative gameplay mechanics. The game seamlessly blends traditional platforming elements with creative level design. Each level presents a new challenge, requiring players to master their timing and reflexes.

The controls are intuitive, making it easy for players of all skill levels to pick up and play. Whether you’re navigating treacherous terrains, dodging enemies, or collecting power-ups, the gameplay is fluid and responsive. The developers have clearly put a lot of thought into ensuring that each action feels satisfying and rewarding.

[h3]A community-driven experience[/h3]

While Cat Dimension is already a fantastic game, the developers are committed to making it even better. This is where your feedback comes in. After a year of development, we find ourselves in the "Steam graveyard" with hardly any feedback to guide us. Improving a game without player input is challenging, and we need your help to make Cat Dimension the best it can be.

Your feedback can cover a wide range of areas, from gameplay mechanics and level design to character development and story elements. Perhaps there’s a particular jump that you found too challenging, or maybe you have ideas for new features that could enhance the game. Whatever your thoughts, the developers are eager to hear from you and incorporate your suggestions into future updates.

[h3]An opportunity to support indie developers[/h3]

Purchasing Cat Dimension at an 80% discount not only gives you access to a wonderful game but also supports indie developers. Creating a game is a labor of love, and smaller development teams often rely on the support of the gaming community to continue their work. By buying the game and providing feedback, you’re playing a crucial role in helping indie developers thrive.

Indie games like Cat Dimension offer a refreshing alternative to mainstream titles. They often bring unique ideas and creativity to the table, resulting in experiences that stand out from the crowd. Supporting indie developers ensures that the gaming industry remains diverse and vibrant, with a wide range of games for players to enjoy.

[h3]A thriving community of players[/h3]

Cat Dimension has the potential to garner a dedicated fanbase, and with your help, the community can grow. Joining this community allows you to connect with other players, share tips and strategies, and participate in discussions about the game. The developers are active in the community, regularly engaging with players and sharing updates about future plans.

Being part of a gaming community adds another layer of enjoyment to the experience. You can exchange stories about your adventures in Cat Dimension, collaborate on overcoming particularly tricky levels, and celebrate each other’s achievements. The sense of camaraderie and shared passion for the game makes it even more enjoyable to play.

[h3]Why now is the perfect time to buy[/h3]

With Cat Dimension currently available at an 80% discount, there’s no better time to jump in and start your adventure. The discount makes it an incredibly affordable option, allowing more players to experience the magic of this delightful game. Whether you’re buying it for yourself or as a gift for a friend, you’re getting incredible value for your money.

Moreover, by purchasing the game now, you’ll be among the first to experience new updates and features as they’re released. The developers are committed to continually improving Cat Dimension, and your early support helps ensure that they have the resources to keep enhancing the game.

[h3]How to provide feedback[/h3]

Providing feedback on Cat Dimension is easy and straightforward. After playing the game, you can share your thoughts through various channels. The Steam community page is a great place to start, where you can leave reviews, join discussions, and post your suggestions. Additionally, the developers may provide surveys or feedback forms to gather more detailed insights from players.

When providing feedback, be as specific as possible. Detail the aspects of the game you enjoyed, as well as any areas where you think improvements could be made. Constructive feedback is incredibly valuable, as it helps the developers understand what works well and what needs adjustment.

[h3]Future updates and expansions[/h3]

The journey of Cat Dimension doesn’t end with its current release. The developers have exciting plans for future updates and expansions, which will introduce new content, features, and improvements based on player feedback. By participating in the feedback process, you have the opportunity to influence the direction of these updates.

Future expansions may include new levels, additional characters, enhanced gameplay mechanics, and more. The goal is to keep the game fresh and engaging, providing players with new challenges and experiences to enjoy. Your input is key to ensuring that these updates meet the community’s expectations and continue to enhance the overall game.

[h3]Final thoughts[/h3]
Cat Dimension is more than just a game; it’s a charming, engaging adventure that captures the imagination. With its current 80% discount on Steam, there’s no better time to dive into this delightful world. The combination of a heartwarming storyline, innovative gameplay mechanics, and a vibrant community makes it a must-play for gamers of all ages.

By purchasing Cat Dimension, you’re not only treating yourself to a fantastic gaming experience but also supporting indie developers and contributing to the game’s future development. Your feedback is invaluable, helping to shape updates and expansions that will enhance the game for all players.

So, what are you waiting for? Embark on your adventure in Cat Dimension today, and become part of a community that’s passionate about creating and enjoying extraordinary gaming experiences. Don’t miss out on this pawsome deal – grab your copy now and let the feline fun begin!
